title: Laparoscopic vs Open Hernia Mesh Repair for Inguinal Hernia
brief_summary: This study will determine whether laparoscopic and open hernia repair have the same recurrence and complication rates in the under 60yr old age group. The overall financial costs of each repair will also be compared.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male \<60yrs with primary inguinal hernia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Recurrent hernia
* Bilateral hernia
* Non-reducible/obstructed hernia
* Previous lower abdominal surgery/radiotherapy
